alerts.headline: Extreme Heat Warning issued October 2 at 12:32AM PDT until October 8 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Dangerously hot conditions with high temperatures ranging
from the mid 80s to around 90 near the coast to the mid 90s to
around 100 near higher coastal terrain expected. Nights will be
very warm with low temperatures mostly in the 70s.

* WHERE...Orange County Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...From 10 AM this morning to 8 PM PDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Heat related illnesses increase significantly during
extreme heat events.
